env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

logos list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{len .CgoFiles}}' net
stdout '^net 0$'
logos list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{len .CgoFiles}}' os/user
stdout '^os/user 0$'
logos list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' net
[GOOS:darwin] stdout 'cgo_darwin.go'
[!GOOS:darwin] stdout 'cgo_stub.go'
logos list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' os/user
stdout 'lookup_unix.go'
[!GOOS:darwin] ! stdout 'cgo_lookup_unix.go'

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] go list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{len .CgoFiles}}' net
[cgo] [!GOOS:darwin] stdout '^net [1-9][0-9]*$'
[cgo] [GOOS:darwin] stdout '^net 0$'
[cgo] go list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{len .CgoFiles}}' os/user
[cgo] [!GOOS:darwin] stdout '^os/user [1-9][0-9]*$'
[cgo] [GOOS:darwin] stdout '^os/user 0$'
-- go.mod --
module example.com/purego

go 1.27

package marker
